bee_file.name: reference_writer
bee_file.note: Written by bee_rpc.client.write_to_file, not by this script.

parse.name: one_block
parse.note: An object with one block in its chunk field. Markers: start, content, end.

parse.name: big_block
parse.note: One block of three chunks. Used by the skip vectors.

parse.name: nested_depth1
parse.note: An object that points to a multiblock block and to a file block. The sender frames one level: the inner block content goes flat.

parse.name: nested_depth2
parse.note: The same object, framed two levels deep. The leaf block has its own markers inside the inner block.

parse_errors.name: unknown_head_index
parse_errors.note: Head index 9 is not accepted: the parser must refuse it.

python_parse.message: Parse from buffer error: buffer head index is not correct 9dict_keys([1, 0])

parse_errors.name: headless_message
parse_errors.note: A Buffer with no head goes to index 1 when index 1 is accepted.

parse_errors.name: message_without_separator
parse_errors.note: The stream ends with no separator. The reference yields what it has.

parse_errors.name: intersecting_blocks
parse_errors.note: Block A opens, block B opens, then A closes before B: not allowed.

python_parse.message: gRPCbb: IntersectionError: Intersections between blocks are not allowed.

parse_errors.name: nesting_at_limit
parse_errors.note: 32 nested blocks: the limit, accepted. Each id is the hash of its expansion.

python_parse.message: gRPCbb: blocks nested more than 32 deep.

parse_errors.name: block_id_mismatch
parse_errors.note: The content does not hash to the block id: refused (reference disk mode).

python_parse.message: bee-rpc: the received block 70d020810260888757f172ce3a79e2359bac4bd366485333b8988b8aad7943e4 hashes to 73a38b9e525c9c2ae262feeaa3c2947ab19bce3a173f075c75341e5e7fa080b6. Its content is not what its id

parse_errors.name: block_without_hash_type
parse_errors.note: DEVIATION D2: a block marker on the wire with no hash type. The reference does not see a block and ends the message there. The Rust parser refuses it.

serialize.name: empty_message
serialize.note: An Empty message: one Buffer with head index 1, an empty chunk, separator.

serialize.name: bytes_small
serialize.note: Raw bytes always use index 0. Head{index: 0} is present but has no fields.

serialize.name: three_messages
serialize.note: Three messages with indices 1, 2 and 0, in one stream.

serialize.name: bytes_chunk_minus_one
serialize.note: The largest payload that still goes in one Buffer.

serialize.name: bytes_chunk_exact
serialize.note: CHUNK_SIZE bytes: head, one chunk, separator (three Buffers).

serialize.name: head_large
serialize.note: A message larger than CHUNK_SIZE under index 1.

skip.name: none
skip.note: No skip request: the output is the input.

skip.name: before_start
skip.note: The request is there before the block starts: start and end markers only.

skip.name: mid_block
skip.note: The request arrives after the first chunk of the block: the rest is dropped, the end marker is kept.

skip.name: nested_child
skip.note: Skip the inner leaf block only.

skip.name: nested_parent
skip.note: Skip the parent: its children markers are dropped too, its end marker is kept.

strip_skips.name: inert_removed
strip_skips.note: A Buffer with only a skip request (and its empty chunk) is removed.

strip_skips.name: payload_kept
strip_skips.note: A skip request on a Buffer with payload: the skip field is cleared, the Buffer is kept.
